notes:
Version 2.4.0.0 — Play setup and player avatars

Play now has a unified setup layout with profile-picture player selection,
consistent seat and deck cards, grouped game options, and a fixed Start Game button.
The full player picker blocks duplicates and supports clearing a seat.
Selections survive rotation, with a two-column layout on wider screens.
Quick picks use recent-player ordering when supported by the server,
with alphabetical ordering on older servers.
